name: InlineLoader
description: A compact, centered spinning loader intended for inline or section-level loading states. Renders a Loader2 icon inside a flex container with vertical padding.

accessibility.keyboard: No keyboard interaction; purely visual indicator.
accessibility.aria: No explicit ARIA attributes. Consider wrapping with role="status" and aria-label for screen reader announcements.
accessibility.notes: Displays a spinning Loader2 icon (h-9 w-9) centered horizontally with py-6 vertical spacing. Uses text-primary for the spinner color.
